subject: GLOBAL clause
notes: kb/Work PB1193 LANDED (wave 68 Y). SR3 'If the GLOBAL clause is not specified in the file description entry of a containing program, the file shall not be referenced directly or indirectly by any input-output statements in any contained program' (cite.py OK 13.18.27.3 3)). DIRECT references: a non-GLOBAL FD's file-name is merged into no contained unit's FilesByName (BinderDriver: only f.IsGlobal files are), so every contained I/O statement naming it is an undefined name. INDIRECT references are the record-name operands — WRITE / REWRITE (their SR21 / SR3) and RELEASE (this SR3, passed as its containedRule) — refused by ResolveRecordName when the record is a GLOBAL record of a container's non-global FD (DataBinder.ContainerLocalFiles). The EXTERNAL exception needs no arm: a contained program that describes the file EXTERNAL has its own FD, so the record-name is not 'defined in a containing program'.
